description: 20-iteration loop/harness-layer study (gpt-5.6-sol high; synthesized by gpt-5.6-sol xhigh; independently verified by DeepSeek V4 Pro, PASS-WITH-FIXES applied) of the NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents (NOOA) research paper plus the 12 graph-engineering blogs. The loop/harness counterpart to the four graph-layer studies: extracts validated typed iteration returns, agent-curated non-authoritative memory, model-callable context APIs, programmable-but-bounded LEAF tactics, a three-layer eval architecture, and a loop/harness mutant corpus for system-deep-loop's own loop engine, all subordinate to the 036 authority plane (which currently runs dark).
